reason: Both plans meet all hard requirements, but B places the full production backup before setting up replication/CDC (which requires modifying the source), whereas A configures the replication pipeline against production in step 3 before the backup in step 4. B also gives rollback its own dedicated step rather than folding it into a combined 'go-live or rollback' decision, and includes clearer, separately-staged stakeholder communications (advance notice, start-of-window, and closure) rather than a single main notice.
